messages:
jules_cs: Heads-up: OrchardAI renewal in 10 days. They reported slow interactive latency during onboarding and asked if credits are possible. Need a compact evidence pack (route p95/p99, uptime, incident timeline), a recommended credit amount, and a short customer note. I can send the note once we agree.

tariq_eng: I'll pull 60d metrics and route traces. Do we use p95 for their interactive flow?

jules_cs: Yes, p95 for chat.live (they flagged p95), p99 for batch imports.

anya_sre: Infra saw a burst of 5xxs during a cache migration on 2026-02-11 03:20Z for ~6 minutes. Warm pool wasn't yet active. I'll add the postmortem link.

drew_am: Contract: credits above 0.6% need legal sign-off. Recommend staying below that threshold unless we have major failure.

tariq_eng: Quick summary after initial run: chat.live p95 = 290ms (target 200ms), p99 = 720ms (target 600ms), uptime = 99.82% (target 99.9%). ingest.bulk is fine. Main customer-facing gap is chat.live.

jules_cs: Given ~0.08% uptime shortfall and p95 overshoot ~90ms, suggested credit?

drew_am: Propose 0.3% invoice credit plus a free 1-hr optimization session. Keeps us under 0.6% and shows proactive support.

finance-bot: Placeholder calc: 0.3% of last committed month = $Z (will replace after invoice line confirmed).

anya_sre: I'll attach the incident note and config change diff: /postmortems/orchardai/2026-02-11.md

tariq_eng: Uploaded CSV of per-route percentiles: https://console.redwood.ai/exports/orchardai/60d-slo.csv and traces bundle: https://console.redwood.ai/traces/orchardai/2026-03-01.tar.gz

jules_cs: Draft customer note outline: 1) Acknowledge the impact; 2) attach SLO snapshot + per-route table; 3) explain root cause and fixes (cache migration + warm pool); 4) offer 0.3% credit or credit waived if they accept the optimization session; 5) ask if they'd like a technical deep dive.

drew_am: Add legal-safe phrasing: "One-time invoice credit equal to 0.3% of the monthly committed spend for the affected month, without admission of liability."

jules_cs: Action items:
- tariq_eng: confirm final numbers and paste the three worst windows (ETA 3h)
- anya_sre: paste postmortem and mitigation steps (ETA EOD)
- drew_am: final credit wording and approval path (ETA EOD)
- finance-bot: compute dollar amount once invoice line provided

tariq_eng: Will drop the windows and a quick trace excerpt.

jules_cs: I'll assemble the bundle and share the draft note internally before sending. Ping me for reviews. :thumbsup:

evidence-bot: Snapshot saved to /evidence/orchardai/2026-03-01-slo-snapshot.tar.gz

jules_cs: Closing thread for now, will reopen if new data shows up."
